---
title: Write a workflow
description: Chain scripts, tools, agents, sub-workflows and human gates.
---

<Status state="planned" />

| Step | Runs | Uses AI? |
|---|---|---|
| `script:` | A pack script | No |
| `tool:` | A connector tool, by capability or name | No |
| `agent:` | A role, optionally with a pack | Yes |
| `workflow:` | Another workflow | Only if it has agent steps |
| `gate:` | A person: approval or input | No |

Per step: `needs`, `if`, `foreach` with `max_parallel`, `retry`, `timeout` and `on_failure`.
Expressions stay simple (`${{ steps.x.output }}`); anything complex belongs in a script.

`bimai validate` checks the file, the order (no loops) and that every pack and capability exists.
`bimai workflow plan` shows the parallel lanes and expected cost before you run it. See the
meeting-intake workflow in `packs/meeting-intake/workflows/` for a complete example.
